description: Searches the developer's judgment graph: past decisions people made on cases like this one, closest first, with the answer and how strongly they agreed. Returns a suggestion only when the case is settled: several close cases with the same options, all decided the same way with strong agreement. Free. To act on a settled case and have it recorded and billed as a decision, call ask_humans with use_precedent instead.

app.description: Only this app. Default: PLURES_APP, then all apps

context.description: The material to judge, as plain text

limit.description: How many past decisions to return. Default 5

options.description: The possible answers; a suggestion needs past cases with the same options

question.description: The decision, worded as you would ask it

name: find_precedents
title: Find how people decided similar cases
